sentences.translation: # First time room search
Tanaka Yuki decided to get a job for the first time this spring.
The new workplace is in Shinjuku, so I want to be able to live near it, but the budget was limited to less than 60,000 yen a month.
On Saturday morning, Yuki stepped into the real estate store in front of the station.
"Welcome. What kind of room are you looking for today?"
Mr. Yamamoto, who is in charge, greeted me with a smile.
Yuki expressed hope with a little nervousness.
"We're looking for 1K, which is less than 60,000 yen, within 20 minutes by train to Shinjuku. I hope the number of years of construction is not very old..."
Yamamoto operated a personal computer and proposed several properties.
The first thing I showed you was 1K on the third floor of the three-story apartment building.
The photo showed a good sunnyness and the eyes of the yuki were caught.
"This is a rent of 5,000 yen, and the management fee is 3,000 yen. It was a month of raikin, two months of deposit, and a month of intermediary fees. There are also washing machines."
Yuki checked whether he could keep a pet.
According to Mr. Yamamoto, unfortunately, it seems that the property is not pet-friendly.
The next thing I was guided was that it was a little cheaper property, but it was north-facing and I could hardly expect sunlight.
Yuki compared the two rooms in his head.
I thought that I could spend a nice day in the sunshine room on the third floor.
"I'd like to make the first property that you introduced. Can you explain the application procedure?"
Mr Yamamoto prepared the application form immediately.
He also carefully explained the guarantor and the date on which he could move in.
Yuki felt a little nervous and her expectations for a new life escalated.
